career.meta_description_list: Open roles at Codiva.dev. Join the team and send your CV in minutes.
career.apply_intro: Fill in the form and attach your CV as a PDF.
career.discipline_gate: Choose your testing craft. Each one has its own criteria test.
career.consent_data: I agree to the processing of my personal data and CV for recruiting.
career.consent_terms_prefix: I have read and accept the
career.apply_success: Thank you. We received your application.
career.apply_error: We could not send the application. Check the details and try again.
career.error_duplicate: We already received an application from you for this role recently.
career.error_rate: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
career.assessment_start_intro: For {{role}} we ask a short situational test. It is not jargon trivia — it is operating judgment.
career.assessment_rule_time: Eight questions, 15 minutes. The timer starts when you begin.
career.assessment_rule_pass: You need 70% on the criteria test.
career.assessment_rule_hunt: Then report one finding in your craft on the site. That unlocks the CV form.
career.assessment_rule_required: Answers, progress, and findings are recorded for the recruiting team.
career.assessment_gate: You need to pass this role’s criteria test and report a finding in your craft before you can send a CV.
career.assessment_rank_hint: Rank from first to last with the arrows.
career.assessment_pass_body: You can apply to this role now. The form will use your name and email.
career.assessment_pass_hunt_title: Next: a finding in your craft
career.assessment_pass_hunt_body: The criteria test is done. Now walk the site, find a defect in your craft, and report it with evidence. That closes the same test.
career.assessment_fail_body: Thanks for the time. You can retry later; the team still sees this attempt.
career.assessment_fail_hint: There is a 12-hour wait between attempts, and a maximum of two per week.
career.assessment_timed_out: Time ran out. We scored what you had answered.
career.assessment_error: We could not load or submit the test. Try again.
career.assessment_cooldown: You already used a recent attempt. Wait a bit before retrying.
career.assessment_max_attempts: You reached this week’s attempt limit for this role.
career.assessment_pick_title: Choose the craft for this test
career.assessment_pick_body: These are specialist testers. Each craft has its own judgment test and planted findings on the site.
career.assessment_required_error: You must pass the test with the same email before applying.
career.list_intro: Custom software, in production. Review open positions and send your CV in a few minutes.
career.empty_body: Check back soon, or write to us if you want to collaborate with Codiva.dev.
career.assessment_meta_description: Criteria test for the {{title}} opening at Codiva.dev.
career.meta_description_detail: {{title}} opening at Codiva.dev. Review the role and apply with your CV.
career.hunt_cta: Found something? It’s part of the test — report it with evidence.
career.hunt_meta: Report a finding on Codiva.dev. Steps, expected vs. actual, and URL.
career.hunt_intro: For testers this is the second part of the same test: situational judgment, then a real finding in your craft. Some issues are planted; some may be real. Don’t guess — report URL, steps, and evidence.
career.hunt_rule_1: Say where you saw it (URL) and how to reproduce it.
career.hunt_rule_2: Separate a defect from a preference. The finding must match your craft.
career.hunt_rule_3: You don’t need to inspect the code: if it isn’t visible or usable, it counts less.
career.hunt_form_intro: One finding per submission. If you find several, send several reports.
career.hunt_field_description: What you saw and how to reproduce it
career.hunt_field_description_hint: Steps, actual result, and viewport, keyboard, or network if relevant.
career.hunt_success_body: If it was in your craft, you can continue to apply. The team matches it to your email.
career.hunt_keep_going: Received, but this report does not close the test for your craft. Keep looking for a finding in that specialty.
career.hunt_gate: You passed the criteria test. Report a finding in your craft to unlock the CV form.
career.hunt_required_error: You need to report a finding in your craft before applying.
career.hunt_browse: Browse the site and come back here to report
career.hunt_craft_hint_frontend: Frontend craft: keyboard, HTML semantics, and what is visible or usable on screen.
career.hunt_craft_hint_backend: Backend craft: network, APIs, headers, status codes, and the JSON contract.
career.hunt_craft_hint_fullstack: Full-stack craft: it may be in the UI or an API — it counts if the contract does not match what you see.
career.hunt_craft_hint_ux_ui: UX/UI craft: language, accessible names, visual consistency, and click targets.
career.hunt_craft_hint_qa: QA craft: regressions, broken links, and stale data that never got updated.
career.hunt_craft_hint_other: Any finding with evidence counts for this craft.
career.hunt_error: We could not send it. Check the details and try again.
career.hunt_error_rate: Too many reports. Wait a moment.
career.hunt_error_duplicate: We already received a very similar report from you recently.
